what_happened: Localized the hotspot in one profiled run plus three #count_heartbeats A/B probes: cumulative simp is 14988s of the module's ~15100s total elaboration (1348 simp calls above 200ms, median 5.55s), while unfold/split is only ~108s. Replacing 'unfold applyRule + repeat split + all_goals simp_all only' with the already-generated per-arm equation lemmas applyRule.eq_1..eq_37 cut applyRule_andPos_closed from 882487 to 760 heartbeats (1161x), applyRule_serialityRule_closed from 2084589 to 146 (14278x), applyRule_boxNeg_closed from 885047 to 27178 (32.6x).

The module's own inline comments misattribute the cost: 36 copies of '-- unfold applyRule reduces the 36-arm match to this rule's arm: about 0.9M heartbeats measured' and the NonAnalytic section note blaming whnf arm-position. The 0.9M heartbeat figure is accurate for the whole declaration but the profiler shows the cost is the all_goals simp_all cascade, not unfold/split. These comments must be rewritten, not preserved, or they will steer the next reader wrong.
